ucs.t: Decide whether finished work is actually finished
ucs.s: Evaluate a contract line by line instead of accepting a sentence that says the work is done.

ucs.t: Add a use case and let the tool prove it
ucs.s: Scaffold a draft for an uncovered command, validate it, run its scenario against the real tool, and see the coverage move.

ucs.t: Adopt a repository that already has its own rules
ucs.s: Install the supervisory layer into a repository with a hand-written CLAUDE.md, without the tool taking ownership of a file somebody else wrote.

ucs.t: Block acceptance on a question nobody has answered
ucs.s: Open a question against the task, watch finish refuse completion while it is unresolved, resolve it with the answer, and only then complete.

ucs.t: Keep the prompts that started the work, below the model rather than around it
ucs.s: Wire the provider hook, prove it by running a payload through it, and see that a prompt the tool could not parse is reported rather than silently dropped.

ucs.t: Hand work over with a question still open, and keep it blocking
ucs.s: Close a task into a handover while a question is unresolved, start the follow-up task, and see the same question still refuse acceptance there.

ucs.t: Catch an agent that says it is done when it is not
ucs.s: One task, start to finish: a worker strays outside its scope, claims it is finished, hands over, and is accepted only once the repository''s own verification passes.

ucs.t: Checkpoint long work so a stop costs minutes, not the day
ucs.s: Record compact progress inside the active task at the profile interval, so a session that ends without warning leaves the next one a place to start.

ucs.t: Decide what belongs in the AI context, as data
ucs.s: Read the repository’s declared scope policy, see which paths are in and out of the index, and let doctor and the knowledge index apply it rather than a hardcoded list.

ucs.t: Complete an issue only when its evidence exists
ucs.s: See an issue refuse completion while a required piece of evidence is missing, read the roadmap the milestone state derives, and keep the GitHub projection a projection.

ucs.t: Deliver issues in waves the graph computes, and take the next one
ucs.s: Validate the plan, read the execution waves the dependency graph yields, see which issues are ready and which are blocked on what, and take the one issue a worker should do now.

ucs.t: Refuse a directory of the layer that documents nothing
ucs.s: A directory added under the layer without a context document fails validation by name, nothing resolves against the tree until it says what it is for, and the same hierarchy is readable over MCP and the API without running the gate.

ucs.t: Extend what the executable serves by adding a file, never by rebuilding it
ucs.s: Add a rule, a prompt or a knowledge node to .ai/ and have it appear as an MCP resource, an HTTP route and a reference entry, with the same binary.

ucs.t: Find an object of the layer without reading everything
ucs.s: Search durable records literally across kinds from the shell, and ask the shared server the same question over MCP with majordomus_search and majordomus_get.

ucs.t: Find out what has drifted since anyone last looked
ucs.s: Ask what has moved, rather than whether anything is wrong.

ucs.t: Follow a procedure the repository defines, and add another one
ucs.s: Read the repository''s skills, take one as it is written, and add a new one by writing its file — no registry, no code, and a check that says what it examined.

ucs.t: Gate CI on the tool itself, with an exit code that is a contract
ucs.s: Run the checks CI runs, read every finding with the command that reproduces it, and rely on exit codes that mean one thing each: no code means warn and continue.

ucs.t: Hand the repository to someone who cannot clone it
ucs.s: Take a snapshot that a model can read or a gate can run in, without sending anything untracked and without losing the file modes on the way.

ucs.t: Hand unfinished work to the next session
ucs.s: Stop mid-task and leave the next worker something to act on that is not a transcript.

ucs.t: Install the tool in one command, on a machine with no toolchain
ucs.s: Paste one line, get a verified binary for this machine, and run majordomus init — no git, no Rust, no Node, no Python, no root, and no way to install an archive whose digest does not match.

ucs.t: Record a decision so the next worker can find it
ucs.s: Write down what was decided and why as state, then find it again without reading a conversation.

ucs.t: Keep every provider bootstrap thin, generated and within budget
ucs.s: Regenerate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the other provider files from one policy and prove they are stamped, point at the layer, stay under the line budget and resolve every reference.

ucs.t: Keep what an episode learned, without a model and without a conversation
ucs.s: Record a decision inside an episode, derive it into a candidate knowledge record from the ledger, read the evidence that the derivation ran, and watch a second derivation change nothing.

ucs.t: Know whether the work in this checkout is finished
ucs.s: Ask the repository you are standing in, and be told what is still owed by name.

ucs.t: Check the version before trusting a diagnosis
ucs.s: Print the version every other surface derives from, and see the argument it refuses.

ucs.t: Have the session opened and closed without anybody remembering to
ucs.s: Wire the provider''s own session events, and the episode opens when the sitting begins, hands the worker what the last one left, records what a compaction is about to discard, and closes with a continuation record beside its envelope.
ucs.cmd: capture, session, doctor, start, checkpoint, handover

ucs.t: Move a repository from the pre-.ai layout to the layer
ucs.s: See what a migration would move, move it with a backup, and prove the result is a layer the tool reads.

ucs.t: Record what one worker did in one sitting
ucs.s: Open a session, do the work under whatever tasks it touches, and close it into an envelope that references what it produced and copies nothing.

ucs.t: Divide a working tree into commits, and hold every message to a policy
ucs.s: Ask what this tree would commit and why, learn the scope vocabulary from the history rather than a table, and get a verdict on one message or on a whole range before a reviewer has to give one.

ucs.t: Keep the plan as milestones and issues the tool can validate
ucs.s: Declare milestones as outcomes and issues as execution contracts, and let the tool say what is ready and what is blocked.

ucs.t: Prove a rule is actually enforced, not merely written down
ucs.s: Answer "is this rule real?" with a command rather than a reading of the source.

ucs.t: Prove the tool is fast, not assume it, and refuse a regression
ucs.s: Measure every public command and every capability of the executable against a committed baseline, and let the check fail on a regression rather than a reviewer noticing later.

ucs.t: Prove what a task owed before calling it done
ucs.s: A task declares what it owes, records evidence against each obligation, and is refused when that evidence no longer describes the tree it was taken over.

ucs.t: Read back what happened, and keep the ledger within its cap
ucs.s: Read the append-only ledger as operational history, filtered by task and event, validate every line, and rotate the oldest lines into an archive rather than deleting them.

ucs.t: Read only the context that fits the budget, and know what was dropped
ucs.s: Assemble the context a worker needs now in authority order, cut it to a line budget, and see every dropped section named with its reason.

ucs.t: See which rules apply here and what enforces them
ucs.s: List the effective rule set, read one rule as the tool reads it, and see which of them the tool enforces and from where.

ucs.t: Record a decision as data, and prove the tool cannot accept it for you
ucs.s: Read the decisions a repository holds, validate the whole set in one command, and watch the tool refuse to write the one status only a person may write.

ucs.t: Close an episode whose client never came back
ucs.s: A killed provider sends no end event. Close the episode it left open by evidence, exactly once, without claiming work it did not do.

ucs.t: Start a session from a rendered framing, not a pasted transcript
ucs.s: List the prompt assets the repository ships, render one against the durable state, and read the context it embeds.

ucs.t: Resume in the right worktree, never against somebody else’s task
ucs.s: Find the handover that belongs to this worktree and branch, and see a task record from another checkout reported as foreign rather than enforced here.

ucs.t: Run several workers in one repository without them colliding
ucs.s: Give each worker a declared scope, and find out immediately when two of them claim the same paths.

ucs.t: Say what reached the remote and what did not
ucs.s: The obligations that reach past the working tree are settled by asking git and the published site, so a report cannot call uncommitted work committed or unpushed work pushed.

ucs.t: Say what your work is for, once, and have every surface say it
ucs.s: Record an operational failure mode as one file and have the command line, the API, MCP and the website answer it without registering it anywhere.

ucs.t: See what the repository holds, and run one of its capabilities, without reading a file
ucs.s: Open the shared server in a browser and get the whole layer as pages: what exists, where each thing came from, what depends on what, what is failing, and a form that runs any capability.

ucs.t: Serve the repository's AI layer to every AI client through one shared server
ucs.s: Open the repository in any client the tool declares a provider for (docs/generated/providers.md) and have each of them read the same rules, prompts and knowledge over MCP from one process, seeing each other.

ucs.t: Trace a change to the context documents it affects
ucs.s: List the scoped context documents, resolve which apply to a path and why, and find out which documents a change set touches before it lands.

ucs.t: Trust the policy and the profiles only after they are validated
ucs.s: Prove that the canonical policy parses with every key it needs declared, that every profile parses and the default exists, and that what the policy declares as enforced is what actually runs.

ucs.t: Work on a branch in the one worktree it belongs to
ucs.s: Start a branch without choosing a path, find every checkout of the repository from any of them, and bring a stray one home with its uncommitted work intact.
